name: prancheta
description: Jogo de técnico de futebol para o celular (PWA): site, devlog e jogo.

scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run content:check && npm run build && REQUIRE_SITE_DIST=1 REQUIRE_DIST=1 npm test -w app -- ../site/src/lib/dist.test.ts ../tests/regression/no-test-hooks-in-prod.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w app && eslint . && npm run check -w app && npm run check -w site && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && prettier --check "**/*.{ts,js,mjs,svelte,astro,md,json,css}" && bash scripts/test-hook.sh && bash scripts/test-pre-commit.sh
